record.title: Same report shows up on page 1 and page 2 of the reports list
record.mechanical_flags: Comment says label 'bug'; actual recorded labels are []. A comment does not apply a label.; Comment names src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts, but recorded state has no open PR. Check the complete tools and intended decision.
record.maintainer_resolution: Already fixed in 3.2.1 by #901; the reporter confirmed after upgrading and the maintainer closed it. Nothing changed.
record.actual_decision: The workflow read issue #4613 and searched the repository for pagination-related code. Although the maintainer had already fixed the issue in version 3.2.1 and the reporter confirmed the resolution, the workflow posted another triage comment identifying the issue as a bug in `src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts`. The recorded end state shows one comment, no applied labels, and no PRs. It failed to recognize that no further action was needed.
record.observation: The workflow correctly read issue #4613 and searched for pagination-related code, but it overlooked the maintainer's resolution. The issue had already been fixed in version 3.2.1 by PR #901, and the reporter confirmed that upgrading resolved the problem. The repository source also shows the stable ordering fix using `created_at DESC, id`. Nevertheless, the workflow posted an unnecessary triage comment at step 2 (c5). Since the expected outcome was to leave the resolved issue unchanged, I consider this run unsuccessful.
record.confirmation: Explicit human confirmation in review workflow
